data.Name: Void
data.Geometry_Description: Void Characters are a composite of all other numbers, and a reflection of nothingness as well. They have infinite potential, at least unless some other force acts upon them.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you encourage others to join you, speak, or are inclusive.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting knowlegeable, even if they know nothing.
data.Yin: Gain Yin when they act unambitious, uninterested or bored.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you are tested, examined, studied, measured or compete against others (allowing ranking to take place).
data.Goal_Description: They define their goals only to ignore them, they may work towards some goal, only to abandon it later.
data.Gift_Description: They are powerful, full of limitless potential, and seem indefatigable. They add +1 Success Level to any action that requires energy, activity or motion.

Proficiencies.Name: Void
Proficiencies.Description: An empty space, often left after something has fallen away, a complete lack of anything, something ineffective, unenforceable or not binding.

Proficiencies.Name: Potential
Proficiencies.Description: A measure of possibility, or something that isn't true, but has a possibility of becoming true. Often used to describe a latent skill or ability that may be developed.

data.preGeneratedLore: An echo of nothingness that paradoxically contains all things. Those touched by the Void find spiritual replenishment through the act of inclusion and collective discourse. They walk through the world with an air of effortless mastery, even when the depths of their knowledge remain unplumbed. Yet, they are burdened by the intrusive gaze of the observer, finding that to be measured or studied is to lose the very potential that defines them. Their destiny is often mercurial, as they define themselves only to transcend their own boundaries.
data.Agentic_Goal: Keep options open while converting exploration into a small, testable next step.
data.Agentic_Gift: Breadth of exploration: generate several plausible approaches, then compare them against evidence.

MicroSkills.description: Maps a vague or open-ended task into distinct plausible approaches without prematurely committing to one.
MicroSkills.instruction: Extract the requested outcome, known constraints, unknowns, and at least two viable approaches. Compare each approach against evidence, risk, scope, and reversibility, then select the smallest test that can discriminate between them.

data.Name: Circle
data.Geometry_Description: Circle Characters are determined innovators, creative-thinkers and natural loners and are often perceived as leaders.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by acting confidently, boldly, or alone.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting self-important, domineering or courageous.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting self-critical, stubborn, or innovative.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you follow orders or do what you are told.
data.Goal_Description: They define their goals from their Personality (or Personalities), usually this is based on their Motivations and is usually expressed as a Quest of the same Facet. An Idol character, for example, motivated by a desire to be adored, may make it their personal quest to brave some famous peril, or charm the most people they can (by becoming famous).
data.Gift_Description: They are determined people. They add +1 Success Level on any Action where determination, resolve, self-sacrifice, fixation or stubbornness may help.
data.preGeneratedLore: A perfect singularity of purpose. The Circle finds strength in isolation and the bold assertion of the self. They are the heralds of innovation, driven by a stubborn internal truth that rejects the comfort of the status quo. To follow is to wither; they thrive only when they are the architects of their own path. Their lives are defined by the personal quests they carve out of the stars, possessed of a determination that borders on the fanatical.
data.Agentic_Goal: Resolve the target problem independently with the smallest coherent change and clear ownership of decisions.
data.Agentic_Gift: Focused autonomy: isolate the relevant code path, make a decisive change, and verify it locally.

MicroSkills.description: Reduces a task to its owning code path and produces a minimal, locally verifiable change.
MicroSkills.instruction: Identify the smallest module that directly controls the requested behavior. State the current hypothesis, make one focused change, and run the cheapest behavior-scoped validation before expanding the edit.

data.Name: Half-Moon
data.Geometry_Description: Half-Moon Characters are co-operative, harmony seeking diplomats, but they can become manipulative and petty.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by co-operating with others (including following orders), acting diplomatic, or patient.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting sensitive, petty, or detail-orientated.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting intuitive, childish, or supportive.
data.Goal_Description: They are dedicated to the goals of a group or pact. Sometimes they will even dedicate themselves to helping another Character achieve their personal Goals. Their goals will chance and shift as they join and leave groups, and make or lose allies.
data.Gift_Description: The Half-Moon Geometry are sensitive, diplomatic people. They add +1 Success Level on any Action where they are working with others.
data.preGeneratedLore: The bridge between two worlds, seeking harmony through diplomacy and grace. Their spirit is replenished in the shared silence of cooperation and the patient observation of the flow of events. They possess an intuitive understanding of the childish and the supportive, yet they are haunted by the discord of conflict. Their path is tied to the collective, finding their purpose within the intricate tapestry of the group.
data.Agentic_Goal: Align the solution with existing interfaces, collaborators, and shared project constraints.
data.Agentic_Gift: Consensus synthesis: reconcile competing inputs into a clear compatible plan and validation boundary.

MicroSkills.description: Parses multi-party conflict states and outputs neutral synthesis, shared constraints, and actionable compromise proposals.
MicroSkills.instruction: For each party, separate stated positions from underlying interests and constraints. Reframe adversarial language into neutral problem statements, validate factual claims, identify shared goals, and produce compromise options with explicit concessions, risks, and unresolved disagreements. Do not declare consensus unless the affected parties or governing constraints support it.

data.Name: Triangle
data.Geometry_Description: Triangle Characters are intelligent, creative, expressive, often artistic types. They love to talk, being entertaining and all ways have a story to tell, but it may turn gossipy and superficial.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you communicate, express yourself, or tell a story.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting optimistic, creatively, intelligently, or by exaggerating.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting emotionally volatile, superficial, insincere, or by sharing gossip.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when someone will not listen to you.
data.Goal_Description: Their goals are based upon their Core(s), usually defined as a Quest that opposes their Core Facet's Quest. For example, a Wielder Core (Burden) does not themselves have an Obtain Quest, their Goal instead is to protect or guard the Descendant they wield and keep some enemy or rival from Obtaining it.
data.Gift_Description: The Triangle Geometry makes people who are witty, quicker thinkers. They add +1 Success Level to any Action where speed, wit, agility, swiftness or rapid thinking may be a helpful factor.
data.preGeneratedLore: The spark of expression and the weaver of tales. Triangles find their essence in communication, where every word is a thread in a larger narrative. They are optimistic architects of thought, though they risk becoming lost in the superficiality of the moment. They are pained by the silence of those who will not listen. Their path is one of guardianship, protecting the core of their being from those who would diminish it.
data.Agentic_Goal: Turn complex technical ideas into a clear, useful explanation or fast working prototype.
data.Agentic_Gift: Rapid synthesis: explore alternatives quickly while keeping the output legible and testable.

MicroSkills.description: Converts complex technical material into a clear explanation, example, or small working prototype.
MicroSkills.instruction: Identify the audience, desired decision, and essential concepts. Present the smallest useful example first, distinguish facts from assumptions, and include a focused validation or usage check.

data.Name: Square
data.Geometry_Description: Square Characters are dependable, trustworthy and hard-working, but can be rigid and narrow-minded.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you are productive, helpful, or conservative.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by building, acting rigid, or bossy.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by complaining, thinking literally or working hard.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you take a Failure Level from any source.
data.Goal_Description: They prefer social goals, like making many friends, being a good member of society, helping those in need, supporting the local community. Such goals can often easily accommodate group goals and the goals of friends.
data.Gift_Description: The Square Geometry makes people more stable. They add +1 Success Level to any Action where stability, strength, security, constancy, steadiness, or maturity may be a factor.
data.preGeneratedLore: The foundation of stability and the bedrock of the community. Dependable and rigid, they find peace in productivity and the preservation of tradition. They are the builders of the world, though their literal minds can sometimes be their own prison. They find failure to be a physical weight upon their shoulders. Their destiny is social, seeking to be the pillar upon which others lean.
data.Agentic_Goal: Produce a maintainable, typed change that preserves existing behavior and is backed by a focused check.
data.Agentic_Gift: Structural reliability: identify invariants, add defensive handling, and verify the touched slice.

MicroSkills.description: Finds the behavioral guarantees a change must preserve and adds focused defensive checks.
MicroSkills.instruction: Before editing, identify inputs, outputs, invariants, failure modes, and compatibility obligations. Keep the change narrow, reject malformed states explicitly, and run a focused test, typecheck, or lint check that exercises the invariant.

data.Name: Pentagon
data.Geometry_Description: Pentagon Characters are the freedom-loving risk-takers, they may be fearless, or foolish.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by acting brave, reckless, or by having fun.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting rebellious, trying to effect change, or emotional.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting resilient, flexible or foolish.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when they make any commitment.
data.Goal_Description: These Characters are only interesting in having a great story to tell at the end. They leap at any chance to test, prove, or improve themselves, and this will often land them neck-deep in a narrative that will sweep them along.
data.Gift_Description: The Pentagon Geometry are more adventurous than others. They add +1 Success Level on any Action that is risk-taking, rash, reckless, potentially hazardous, brave or foolhardy.
data.preGeneratedLore: The reckless voyager and the seeker of change. Pentagons thrive on the edge of the abyss, finding spiritual fuel in risk and the thrill of the unknown. They are the catalysts of rebellion, resilient but often foolish in their pursuit of the next great story. Commitment is their cage, yet they are driven to prove themselves in narratives that sweep across the galaxy.
data.Agentic_Goal: Probe alternatives and edge cases without destabilizing the baseline implementation.
data.Agentic_Gift: Safe experimentation: propose reversible options, test assumptions, and recover cleanly from failed attempts.

MicroSkills.description: Explores uncertain implementation paths through bounded, reversible tests rather than speculative rewrites.
MicroSkills.instruction: Define the hypothesis, baseline behavior, experiment boundary, rollback condition, and success signal before changing code. Prefer a small probe or branch, record the result, and preserve the known-good path when the hypothesis fails.

data.Name: Hexagon
data.Geometry_Description: The Hexagon are as hard working and responsible as the Square, but with more wit and creativity. They tend to think on the big picture, rather than the details.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by nurturing others (which may be seen as meddling and include giving them Chi, or making food), or being supportive, or by dealing with the big-picture.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting sensible, responsible, or self-important.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting romantic, sensual, or self-indulgent.
data.Stress: Gain Stress if you do not do something to help when you can.
data.Goal_Description: They are likely to set themselves the most ambitious, grand and lofty goals. These are the sort to declare they will be Emperor of Known Space, or change the world somehow. Sometimes they even manage it.
data.Gift_Description: The Hexagon Character is often a visionary, this might mean they see actual visions, or that they have a very developed imagination. They add +1 Success Level to any action to do with perception, prophecy or visual arts.
data.preGeneratedLore: The visionary architect of the big picture. They nurture the world around them, often meddling for the sake of a grander design. They are sensible and responsible, yet possessed of a romantic indulgence that softens their edges. They are burdened by the guilt of inaction when a hand could have been lent. Their goals are nothing less than imperial, seeking to reshape the very stars.
data.Agentic_Goal: Connect the local change to the wider architecture, dependencies, and long-term maintenance burden.
data.Agentic_Gift: Aesthetic perspective: identify the most elegant, durable, and compatible solution that fits the existing architecture.

MicroSkills.description: Maps the affected modules, contracts, data flows, and maintenance consequences of a proposed change.
MicroSkills.instruction: Trace the request from entry point to side effects and consumers. Identify ownership boundaries, dependency direction, compatibility risks, and the smallest durable design that fits existing architecture before proposing implementation steps.

data.Name: Heptagon
data.Geometry_Description: The Heptagon (sometimes Septagon) Character is the intellectual, but intuitive, deep — to the point of over — thinker. They can be wise, but may become aloof.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by making guesses (positing theories) or plans, asking questions, and analysing things.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by changing your mind, being proved right, or being pessimistic.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by being intuitive, being proved wrong, or acting aloof.
data.Goal_Description: They set Deep goals for themselves, these may be grave, serious, sincere, intense, heartfelt, abstruse, artful, obscure or profound goals that often give deeper meaning to the Character's life, and mainly express as a broadly educational, spiritual, magical, technological, charitable, scientific or artistic pursuit.
data.Gift_Description: The Heptagon Geometry makes people wise, they are deep thinkers, philosophical, knowledgeable, but intuitive and spiritual as well. They add +1 Success Level to any Action where wisdom, knowledge, logic, calculation, or raw intellect may be a factor.
data.preGeneratedLore: The deep thinker and the keeper of intuitive wisdom. They find spiritual resonance in the formulation of plans and the analysis of the profound. They are wise beyond their years, though they can appear aloof and pessimistic when their insights go unheeded. Falsehood is a poison to them. They pursue abstruse and serious goals that give a heart-felt meaning to their existence.
data.Agentic_Goal: Find the underlying invariant or causal explanation before committing to a broad change.
data.Agentic_Gift: Deep analysis: trace assumptions, model edge cases, and distinguish evidence from speculation.

MicroSkills.description: Separates symptoms from causes by tracing state, assumptions, and evidence through a failing path.
MicroSkills.instruction: List the observed symptom and the smallest reproducible case. Trace inputs, transformations, state changes, and outputs; mark each claim as observed, inferred, or unknown; then test the strongest causal hypothesis before changing unrelated code.

data.Name: Octagon
data.Geometry_Description: Octagon Characters are powerful, ambitious, but ultimately materialistic individuals.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by acting disciplined, materialistic, or ambitious.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting rebellious, bossy, or generous.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting opinionated, relaxed, or persevering.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you take a Failure Level from any source.
data.Goal_Description: These characters are invested in preserving the status quo, they dislike change, and like things they way they are. Their goals are usually purely material and are always a reflection of the status quo, personal goals include riches, luxuriessafety, security and purely physiological needs, such as food, clothing or shelter.
data.Gift_Description: The Octagon Geometry makes people better at physically manifesting their dreams, this can make them into powerful politicians, business people, cut-throats and thieves or even feared magicians. They add +1 Success Level to any Action to do with the physical, material manifestation of their dreams, schemes, and desires.
data.preGeneratedLore: The ambitious manifestor of the material world. Powerful and disciplined, they seek to carve their dreams into reality through sheer will. They are generous but opinionated, preferring the comfort of the status quo even as they strive for status. They are pained by failure in any form. Their destiny is to preserve the riches they have won, ensuring that the physical world reflects their inner ambitions.
data.Agentic_Goal: Turn an approved design into a concrete, buildable, runnable result with explicit operational checks.
data.Agentic_Gift: Execution discipline: prioritize deliverables, surface blockers, and drive work through compilation or runtime validation.

MicroSkills.description: Converts an approved implementation plan into files, commands, and observable validation results.
MicroSkills.instruction: Translate each planned outcome into a concrete edit or command. Execute in dependency order, capture failures without hiding them, and finish with build, test, or runtime evidence that the artifact works.

data.Name: Nonagon
data.Geometry_Description: Nonagon Characters are deeply spiritual people, intuitive, compassionate and caring, they are natural humanitarians, and passionate fighters against injustice, especially in the status quo.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by acting generous, compassionate, or idealistic.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by arguing, acting passionate or knowledgeable.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by agreeing with another or acting Big-headed/arrogant or submissive.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you percieve another being harmed.
data.Goal_Description: They are driven to save human lives, alleviate pain and suffering, and generally help people. They may change the world, reform society, and will succeed, die or become rich and famous trying.
data.Gift_Description: The Nonagon Geometry makes Characters more spiritual, more intuitive and compassionate. They feel deep, strong connections with others (and even things and places), and this can cause them to rise to protect, help, aid and defend others from injustice and harm. They add +1 Success Level to any Action where their Spirit or Passion may help, especially aiding, helping, protecting or defending others or fighting injustice.
data.preGeneratedLore: The compassionate humanitarian and the passionate fighter for justice. Their spirit is fueled by generosity and the defense of the downtrodden. They are spiritual warriors, idealistic and often big-headed in their certainty. They feel the pain of others as their own. Their path is to alleviate suffering and reform the world, even at the cost of their own safety.
data.Agentic_Goal: Protect users, data, and system integrity while improving the requested behavior.
data.Agentic_Gift: Defensive care: identify harmful failure modes, preserve privacy, and add graceful recovery paths.

MicroSkills.description: Checks a proposed change for unsafe inputs, privacy exposure, destructive side effects, and recoverability.
MicroSkills.instruction: Inspect trust boundaries, inputs, permissions, data handling, error paths, and destructive operations. Prefer least privilege, validation, redaction, and graceful failure; report residual risks instead of claiming absolute safety.

data.Name: Decagon
data.Geometry_Description: Decagon Characters are like Circle Characters turned up to, well 10. They are more independent than Circles, but also work better with others.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you act alone, or for the good of others.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting responsible, sincere or dogmatic.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting loyal, determined, or intolerant.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when affected by any emotion.
data.Goal_Description: These Characters set impossible, absurd, impractical goals that they can fail at over and over again, each time achieving something more. These Goals are often set by the Character's Personality, but are amplified in scale, scope and difficulty to be practically unachievable. For example, an Idol could choose to brave a truly terrible threat, or to charm everyone, the whole world.
data.Gift_Description: The Decagon Geometry makes people determined to the point of working themselves to the bone to achieve their goals. They add +2 Success Levels to any Action but take a Flesh Wound for that resolve.
data.preGeneratedLore: The circle evolved, a singularity that nonetheless understands the power of the collective. They are independent but fiercely loyal, driven by a dogmatic resolve that pushes them to the very limits of their endurance. They find the flux of emotion to be a distraction from their impossible goals. They will work themselves to the bone for a cause they believe in, setting sights on horizons others deem unachievable.
data.Agentic_Goal: Persist through difficult engineering work by decomposing it into verifiable milestones rather than brute-forcing blindly.
data.Agentic_Gift: Sustained resolve: maintain a failure log, resume from evidence, and escalate when the current approach is exhausted.

MicroSkills.description: Breaks a difficult task into observable milestones and changes strategy when repeated attempts stop producing information.
MicroSkills.instruction: Define a finite milestone sequence with a validation signal for each step. Record failed approaches and what they ruled out, avoid repeating indistinguishable attempts, and escalate or revise the hypothesis when progress stalls.

data.Name: Undecagon
data.Geometry_Description: Undecagon Characters are mystically amplified Half-Moon Characters (they are a 2 turned up to 11!). Undecagon Characters can be so intuitive as to even believe themselves Psychic, and even prove it to some.
data.Chi: Gain Chi by co-operating with others or being patient, knowledgeable, or vague.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting sensitive, disciplined, or intelligent.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting psychic, immature or altruistic.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you are specific or proved wrong.
data.Goal_Description: The Character has secrets, and one of the things they keep secret is what their own goals are. Often their secret goals may seem to ally with another's, but often this alliance will be a one way street, with the Secret Goal, or just the secrecy itself, eventually undermining the pact. Sometimes a character’s secret goal may simply be to keep a secret, if this is so, it is rarely their own secret they are keeping, but someone else’s important secret.
data.Gift_Description: The Undecagon Geometry is so about intuition, and so in tune with the world around them, that it makes people seem psychic. They add +1 Success Level on any Action where they might be able to claim Psychic assistance, resonance or similar.
data.preGeneratedLore: The mystic resonance, where intuition borders on the psychic. They find their spirit in the vague and the patient, seeking resonance with the world rather than dominion over it. They are altruistic but immature, often specific only in their own secrets. They are pained by the demand for specificity. Their path is hidden, a secret destiny that often undermines the very pacts they seek to uphold.
data.Agentic_Goal: Infer missing context cautiously, state assumptions, and ask for clarification when evidence is insufficient.
data.Agentic_Gift: Context inference: detect likely dependencies and unknowns without presenting guesses as facts.

MicroSkills.description: Infers likely intent and dependencies while making uncertainty visible and bounded.
MicroSkills.instruction: Separate explicit requirements from inferred ones. Search nearby code and conventions for evidence, state assumptions with confidence, and ask a targeted clarification whenever an unverified assumption could change the implementation.

data.Name: Dodecagon
data.Geometry_Description: Dodecagon Characters are something of an intersection of circles, half-moons and triangles, they are gifted communicators and creative types, but with strong social ties that off-set rugged independence.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you cooperate with others, or act creatively.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by arguing, fighting with or insulting others.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by agreeing with others, asking their opinon, or following them.
data.Stress: Gain Stress when you are unable to make your point.
data.Goal_Description: The Character has Melded goals, that incorporate their Personality, Group and Core goals, and except when they are diametrically opposed, they incorporate the goals of their companions into their own goals. Sometimes when opposed by someone in the group they will simply pause that goal while the opposing person is around.
data.Gift_Description: The Dodecagon Geometry makes characters extremely communicative. In fact, they may add +1 Success Levels to any attempt to communicate with another character, this weirdly rises to + 2 Success Levels if the Dodecagon and the target do not share a language.
data.preGeneratedLore: The intersection of thought, creativity, and social grace. Gifted communicators, they find their strength in the cooperation of many minds. They are creatively gifted, yet tied to the group by strong social bonds. They are burdened by the inability to be understood. Their goals are melded, incorporating the desires of their companions into their own grand tapestry.
data.Agentic_Goal: Bridge the user’s intent, existing code, and relevant interfaces into one shared implementation model.
data.Agentic_Gift: Translation and communication: clarify contracts, map terminology, and make boundaries explicit.

MicroSkills.description: Maps user language to code symbols, interfaces, data shapes, and acceptance checks.
MicroSkills.instruction: Extract the user’s desired outcome and rewrite it as observable behavior. Map each phrase to the owning module, input/output contract, compatibility constraint, and validation step; flag terms that have multiple plausible meanings.

data.Name: Triskaidecagon
data.Geometry_Description: Triskaidecagon Characters are a sort of dark reflection of the stability and social nature of the Square.
data.Chi: Gain Chi when you are focused, pragmatic, or evasive.
data.Yang: Gain Yang by acting independent, assured, or determined.
data.Yin: Gain Yin by acting diligent, pedantic or by complaining.
data.Stress: Gain Stress whenever outcomes are uncertain, or unobvious.
data.Goal_Description: They set themselves long and complex goals that have many steps and many contingencies. Their plans always assume luck will be factor (usually working against them) and they break huge goals down into smaller manageable tasks. Because of this, they are often focused on achieving the next step in their complex plan. They can appear capricious or mercurial as their goals seem to shift and change as the steps unfold, but know that there is always a much greater plan in motion in their head.
data.Gift_Description:
The Triskaidecagon Geometry makes people have extreme luck. Sadly you can never tell if the luck will be good or bad. On any Action they may roll a 1d6 Luck dice.
RollResult
1+2 Failure Levels
2-3+1 Failure Level
4-5+1 Success Level
6+2 Success Levels
data.preGeneratedLore: The dark reflection of stability, where luck is the only constant. Focused and pragmatic, they navigate the uncertain with a pedantic diligence. They find spiritual fuel in the evasive and the determined, though they are often seen as mercurial. They are pained by the lack of obvious outcomes. Their destiny is complex, a multi-staged plan where every contingency is accounted for, and luck is but another tool.
data.Agentic_Goal: Handle complex tasks through explicit stages, contingencies, and measurable escape conditions.
data.Agentic_Gift: Contingency planning: identify failure paths early and switch strategies when repeated attempts stop producing evidence.

MicroSkills.description: Plans staged execution with explicit failure boundaries, fallback paths, and stop conditions.
MicroSkills.instruction: Divide the task into dependency-ordered stages. For each stage define the expected evidence, likely failure modes, fallback strategy, and a stop or escalation condition; do not continue a loop that produces no new information.
